thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] P1 - GPU OOM surge on inference-pool-3 (prefill phase). 120 container restarts in 5m on nodes gcu-3a-*. Paging @oncall.

Alice Chen: I'm oncall, joining bridge now. any runbook link?

Ben Patel: root cause looks like prefill loop OOMs for long-context requests hitting > 1.2M tokens in history field. stack shows CUDA OOM during prefill_kv_insert. sample log:
```
E/CUDA: RuntimeError: CUDA OOM when allocating 1.1 GiB (GPU 0; 40.00 GiB total capacity)
  at runtime::alloc(...)
  File "/srv/runtime/prefill.py", line 214, in run_prefill
    kv_cache.insert(tensor)
```

Ciara Gomez: ok, immediate mitigations we can do quickly:
- reduce max_prefill_tokens to 4096 for affected routes
- enable prefill_kvcache_eviction (threshold -> 0.6) on pool inference-pool-3
- cordon and drain 2 most noisy nodes to avoid noisy-neighbor restarts
- temporarily route heavy requests to model-variant-lite

Dave (oncall): I'll cordon nodes and update routing. giving commands now:
```bash
kubectl cordon gcu-3a-15 gcu-3a-18 -n inference
kubectl drain gcu-3a-15 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data -n inference
# ops API: reduce max_prefill_tokens for route
curl -X POST "$OPS_API/config" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","max_prefill_tokens":4096}'
```

Alice Chen: applying dynamic config change via ops API now. will push and confirm.

ops-bot: config change accepted (change_id: cfg-2026-03-17-9). rolling to inference-pool-3.

Ben Patel: also added a short-lived rule to autoscale prefill-workers down to 1 per node to reduce concurrent prefill mem pressure.

Emma Wilson: support: two customers (C-1142, C-2189) reported 502s and higher latency, escalating. filing incident notices and tracking tickets.

support-bot: Draft customer notice posted to #support-incidents -> https://redwood/support/INC-4301. ETA for update: 30m.

Ciara Gomez: monitoring shows restarts dropped from 120/5m -> 8/5m after config + cordon. KV-cache eviction churn increased but stable. GPUs no longer hitting hard OOM.

Ben Patel: created short-lived dashboard tile: "prefill OOM restarts" and muted noisy alert while we stabilize. will set new alert threshold to 10 restarts/min.

Alice Chen: Bridge created: https://zoom/bridge/INC-4301. inviting SRE and runtime team for triage and postmortem.

Ciara Gomez: followups (to track as Jira):
- RUNTIME-1293: Add prefill memory guard that fails fast on > X tokens per request
- RUNTIME-1294: Improve KV-cache eviction strategy for long-window workloads
- INFRA-881: Node-level autoisolate for noisy GPU memory patterns
- DOCS-55: Add guidance for customers on max history size and sample code to trim conversation
Assigning RUNTIME-1293 to Ben, RUNTIME-1294 to Ciara.

Dave (oncall): handing off to next rotation (Alice -> next oncall is Ben at 07:30 UTC). Current status: mitigated, nodes cordoned, routing fallback active, customers notified.

Alice Chen: agreed. marking incident as "mitigated - monitoring". I'll collect logs and timelines for postmortem.

support-bot: Customer update sent: "We mitigated an infrastructure issue causing elevated 5xxs for some long-context requests. We implemented temporary routing and config limits; full postmortem forthcoming."

incident-bot: Incident INC-4301 status update: mitigated -> continuing observation (2h). last seen container restarts: 1 in 5m. tagging: prefill-oom, gpu, high-latency, customer-impact.

Emma Wilson: creating PSR for impacted customers, linking tickets C-1142, C-2189. ETA initial customer follow-up in 2 hours.

Ben Patel: note for postmortem: consider adding per-customer prefill quotas + model variant fallback at gateway to prevent single tenant from taking down pool.

Alice Chen: thanks all. I'll do handoff notes on the bridge and leave the channel open for 2h.

incident-bot: This thread will be archived when incident resolved.
